title: Two-norm hypercontractivity for larger exponents
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $q>2$, and $f$ a real-valued function on $\{-1,1\}^n$. Applying the noise operator with parameter $1/\sqrt{q-1}$ to $f$ gives a function whose uniform $L^q$ norm is at most the uniform $L^2$ norm of $f$.
